description: This file defines a utility for aggregating agent usage and cost data across multiple MongoDB collections, specifically 'session_tracking' and 'llm-costs'. It processes financial data with currency strings, combines various data sources, applies filtering, and returns summarized metrics including costs, tokens, and session counts per agent.
external_files: Assumed to be imported elsewhere in project setup

methods.name: toNumberSafe(value)
methods.description: Converts various currency-like string inputs (e.g., '$123.45', '1,234.56') or numeric inputs into a safe number, defaulting to 0 otherwise.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost( db, { tenant_id, project_id, from, to, limit = 50, offset = 0, } = {} )
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that queries and aggregates agent usage and cost data from MongoDB collections, supports filtering by tenant, project, date range, and implements merging of data sources to produce summarized metrics.
